summary: Phase B+C validated. Backend: 36/36 tests pass (6 new test_phase_bc.py + regressions test_phase_a/portal/portal_phase2 all green). Evidence upload flow works end-to-end: client POST /api/client/projects/{id}/files with scope=evidence,criterion_id -> record with status 'pending' + serving URL /api/uploads/evidence/{pid}/{fname} returns HTTP 200 with content; assessment section GET includes evidence[] per criterion; unassigned reviewer denied (404); assigned reviewer approves/rejects; DELETE removes; bad extension .exe -> 400. Assignment depth: GET /api/admin/portal/reviewers returns active_assignments/max_workload/available/project_types (fixed defaulting for legacy reviewers). POST /api/admin/portal/assign persists due_date+priority+instructions and appends assignment_history entry; reassign to a different reviewer sets reassigned=true and pushes 'reassigned'; unassign sets reviewer_id=null, status='submitted' and pushes 'removed'; GET certification-projects/{id} returns assignment + assignment_history. Full project form: building_info (built_up_area, target_area, site_area, num_floors, permanent/visitor occupancy, dates, description, parent_development), location incl. nested geo {lat,lng,source}, privacy {confidential,owner_developer,organization,architect,main_contact}, settings.target_rating, and team[] all persist and roundtrip via GET. Residential now allowed at project creation. Frontend: /portal/projects/new is a 6-step wizard (data-testid step-0..step-5) with Details/Building Info/Location/Privacy/Media/Team; Location step renders GeoLocationField (geo-location-field) with 3 mode tabs (geo-mode-current/map/manual). Manual mode: lat=91 rejected (no geo-value set); lat=12.9716, lng=77.5946 accepted, geo-value shows '12.97160, 77.59460 · manual'. Map mode: leaflet-container and leaflet-tile-pane render without console errors, marker pin loads from unpkg. 'Use my location' click in headless (denied) does not crash and page stays up. 'Create project' final button lands on project overview. Assessment section: 6 evidence-upload-{critId} controls render (2 mandatory + 4 optional). Uploading a PDF via evidence-input shows the file with 'Pending review' badge and an evidence-del-{fileId} X button. Admin AssignModal: opens via assign-open-{id}; renders reviewer cards (assign-reviewer-{id}) with workload counts (e.g. '0/3 active' + specialisation + supported types), assign-due, assign-priority (low/normal/high/urgent), assign-instructions, assign-confirm-btn ('Reassign' label when project already assigned), assign-remove-btn visible for assigned projects, and assign-history list showing prior 'Assigned · Test Reviewer' entry. Add-reviewer modal exposes rev-spec, rev-type-Commercial, rev-type-Residential, rev-workload as required.

minor.issue: Legacy reviewers created before the project_types/rating_systems/specialisation fields lacked those keys — API returned them as-is. Fixed in portal.py by setdefault([]/None) so response is always shape-stable.

issues: Modal shows a full-modal Spin while the project detail is being fetched, hiding the reviewer cards passed in as a prop. If /api/admin/portal/certification-projects/{id} is slow (>1s) the modal is briefly all-blank. Consider rendering reviewer cards + due/priority immediately (they only depend on `reviewers` prop) and only guarding the history + Reassign/Remove button logic on `detail`. Non-blocking — endpoint is fast.

action_items: (Optional polish) Render AssignModal reviewer cards + inputs immediately without waiting on project-detail fetch (see design issue).

(Optional) Evidence uploader still shows the 'Attach evidence' button after project is submitted because `editable` on the AssessmentSection comes from backend `editable` flag which is true only in draft/changes_requested — this already handles read-only; regression check confirms hidden control after submit. No action required.
critical_code_review_comments: portal.py grew to 909 lines (25+ handlers). It really should be split into portal_client_assessment.py / portal_reviewer.py / portal_admin.py. Repeat comment from iteration_7 — still not addressed.
portal.py:_save_upload — MAX_UPLOAD is computed from UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE_MB (default 15) but the client error message hardcodes 'max 15 MB' — will drift if env is changed. Use MAX_UPLOAD in the message.

portal.py:upload_client_file allows uploads regardless of project status (assigned, under_review, certified, rejected). Spec says the upload control is hidden after submit on the client UI, but the backend still accepts. Add a status guard (e.g., only draft/changes_requested for scope='evidence') to prevent evidence tampering after submission.
portal.py:reviewer_review_evidence has no editable-status guard — a reviewer could still approve/reject evidence on a 'certified' project. Constrain to REVIEWER_EDITABLE statuses.

GeoLocationField.jsx:manual — when the user types an out-of-range value, the invalid value is silently rejected via toast but the input still shows the invalid text (because it's an uncontrolled-ish onChange that only calls onChange for valid values; the previous value remains). UX would be clearer to keep the input's local state and show a red border/inline error rather than a toast.
GeoLocationField.jsx uses nominatim.openstreetmap.org directly from the browser; the app has no rate-limit or User-Agent handling and could get 429 in production. Consider a proxied backend endpoint.

CertificationPortal.jsx:AssignModal shows workload as '{active_assignments}/{max_workload}' but does not visually flag reviewers whose `available === false` — the reviewer card still looks selectable at overload. Add a warning or disable when overloaded.
Admin certification workspace: the /admin/certification/projects page still fetches ALL projects (no pagination) — will get slow at scale. Same for /reviewers and /clients.

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ / TEST BC prefixed projects and one 'TEST Rev2' reviewer via admin API during runs. Safe to leave or purge by TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests must be invoked with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<public https url> because COOKIE_SECURE=true — cookies won't stick over http/localhost:8001. Run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://earth-solutions-web.preview.emergentagent.com pytest /app/backend/tests -o addopts='' -q`. Residential is a configured rating template (not under_configuration); Hotel & Hospital remain under_configuration. Evidence multipart field is 'file'. Static evidence URL under {FRONTEND_URL}/api/uploads/evidence/{pid}/{filename.ext}. AssignModal loads project-detail before rendering — expect a brief spinner. The 5 reviewer cards observed include duplicates from earlier iterations' TEST Rev2 seeds — safe to ignore.
rca of the issue: Only backend issue found: admin_portal_reviewers returned legacy reviewers without the new project_types/rating_systems/specialisation keys, breaking a shape assertion. Root cause: existing DB documents were created before those fields were added; API did not defensively default them. Fix: setdefault([], None) in the endpoint before returning. Verified with pytest run — all 6 phase_bc tests + full regression pass.
